answer: The sable lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the trellis is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the river of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
